title: Encore: Few-Shot Agentic Discovery of Manipulation Strategies
abstract: arXiv:2609.37359v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents can now write, run, and debug programs with little human help. Robot tasks, however, are usually specified by a sentence that leaves out how to grasp, in what order to make contact, and what the result should look like, and an agent given only the sentence must find these details by trial and error. We introduce ENCORE, which gives the agent a few demonstrations as evidence to read rather than as training data. A deterministic builder distills each demonstration into a pack of multi-view keyframes, gripper events, frame strips, and the full trajectory. A coding agent studies the pack, writes a policy program against a fixed perception and action API, refines it iteratively over a few development rollouts, and freezes it before a sealed evaluation that never reveals the success signal. On LIBERO-PRO, the agent's first program already succeeds in half of the perturbed tasks with demonstrations and in one task without them,

translated_title: Encore：基于少样本智能体的操作策略发现
translated_abstract: 编码智能体如今几乎无需人工帮助就能编写、运行和调试程序。然而，机器人任务通常仅由一句话来指定，这句话省略了如何抓取、以何种顺序进行接触以及结果应该是什么样子，而仅获得这句话的智能体必须通过反复试错来发现这些细节。我们提出了ENCORE，它为智能体提供少量演示作为可阅读的证据，而不是作为训练数据。一个确定性构建器将每个演示提炼成一个数据包，其中包含多视角关键帧、夹爪事件、帧序列条带和完整轨迹。编码智能体研究该数据包，针对固定的感知与动作API编写策略程序，在少量开发rollout中迭代改进该程序，并在密封评估之前将其冻结，该评估从不泄露成功信号。在LIBERO-PRO上，智能体的第一个程序在有演示的情况下已能在半数扰动任务中取得成功，在没有演示的情况下也能完成一项任务。
tldr: ENCORE让编码智能体将少量演示当作证据来阅读而非训练数据，据此自动编写并迭代优化机器人操作策略程序，在LIBERO-PRO上首个程序即可在有演示时完成半数扰动任务。
en_tdlr: ENCORE enables a coding agent to treat a few demonstrations as evidence to read rather than training data, automatically writing and iteratively refining manipulation policy programs, with its very first program succeeding on half of the perturbed LIBERO-PRO tasks when demonstrations are provided.
